user.title: Add station to Charge Station Map
user.description: Provide configuration data. The API key can be read from the [EnBW charge station finder](https://www.enbw.com/elektromobilitaet/unterwegs-laden#ladestations-finder) via the Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key header in your browser's developer tools.

data_description.location: Drag the marker to the center of the area to search, and use the radius handle to set how far around it charge stations are looked up.

search_station.title: Select charge station
search_station.description: Select the station you would like to add from the list below.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Charge Station Map station
reconfigure.description: Update the configuration for this charge station.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Charge Station Map
reauth_confirm.description: The API key was rejected. Please enter a new API key. You can find it in the [EnBW charge station finder](https://www.enbw.com/elektromobilitaet/unterwegs-laden#ladestations-finder) via the Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key header in your browser's developer tools.

filter_stations.title: Filter charge stations
filter_stations.description: Select optional filters from the stations found in the search area, then continue.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the EnBW API. Please try again.
error.no_stations_found: No charge stations were found near the given location.
error.no_filter_matches: No stations match these filters. Change the filters or search area.
error.already_configured: This charge station is already configured.

abort.already_configured: This charge station is already configured.

cannot_connect.message: Failed to connect to the EnBW API.

invalid_auth.message: The API key was rejected by the EnBW API.
